description: We are team of Schools Students, interested in space science and coding
summary: We are The Tech Titans, and our Project is a game that helps players get a glimpse of the struggles and fast critical thinking real life astronauts have to face on a lower complexity level for younger audiences. We leaned into the split second choices an astronaut has to make when an equipment like life support fails or if suddenly an important scientific discovery is found. It is important because it helps the younger generation of aspiring astronauts experience a watered-down version of what a real astronaut will face in space.
details:
Our project is a timed game that lasts 25 minutes but still allows the player to put themselves in professional astronauts' shoes when in space. It has 7 events that make the player think carefully, and the timer helps create a deadline. These events all range from what to do when a major system (like water recycling systems) fails and what choices to make when a radiation event occurs. There are also priority points which essentially act like boosters for each variable such as power and safety. The player also chooses where they land based on the advantages and disadvantages of landing there. It helps players exercise their

  • Logical thinking
  • Identification the root of the problem and trying to rectify it skill
  • Problem solving skill
  • Planning ahead skill
  • Decision making skill
  • Understanding from our mistake skill
  • Managing with the materials given skill

Our game intends to allow players to experience what an astronaut does in space, without actually going to space, and instead, experience it from the comfort of their own homes. We used Chatgpt for a sample blueprint that we referred to when making our own original blueprint that we later sent into Claude to code into text-based coding language that we hosted on Netlify.
